CFO_outlook_commentary.FX_assumption: Approx. 1% headwind to year-over-year total-revenue growth at then-current exchange rates.
CFO_outlook_commentary.expense_change: Lower end raised to incorporate $2.4B legal-proceedings charges recognized in Q2.
CFO_outlook_commentary.other: Company continued to expect full-year operating income above 2025 operating income. No GAAP diluted EPS estimate or numerical Q3 EPS guide stated in captured release.

GAAP_Q2_2026.comparison: Q2 2025 diluted GAAP EPS $7.14; Q2 2026 diluted GAAP EPS $6.18. These are historical Q2 results, not the market’s next-quarter EPS.

path_correction: Initial old investor.fb.com path attempts captured the generic Meta homepage, not the release. Captured old-homepage anchor identified investor.atmeta.com press-release index; one official search result also pointed to the current host. The exact current-host Q2 release was then captured directly. No retry of the failed old-host route.

release_date_and_rule.captured_q2_release: The Q2 release itself is dated Jul 29 and does not state an exact next Q3 publication/call date in the captured body.
release_date_and_rule.market_creation_estimate: 2026-10-21; this is an estimate stated in frozen market description, not a verified issuer-announced earnings date.
release_date_and_rule.time_rule: Frozen rule resolves No if earnings are not released within 45 calendar days of estimated date; thus it does not require publication exactly on Oct 21. Rule provides fallback if release omits GAAP EPS and no EPS appears on Seeking Alpha within 96 hours after market close on earnings-announcement day. No inference about actual Q3 date.

unusual_items_and_gaap.EPS_basis: The release reports diluted EPS $6.18 as a GAAP figure. It supplies no adjusted EPS counterpart in this release; no adjustment has been applied here.
unusual_items_and_gaap.location: Issuer says legal charge recognized in Q2 and costs/expenses include the legal charges and severance; SEC table shows G&A at $5.609B vs $2.663B year ago.
